column1: # ============ *** A FIELD THAT LOOKS LIKE DATA AND IS NOT ============ ***
# *** BOTH INFANT ENTRIES GIVE "AGE: 0 DAYS", AND NEITHER CAN BE TRUE. ***
# The tree has the 1932 boy at *** five days *** (b. 17 May, d. 22 May) and Antoinette at
# *** four *** (b. 3 January, d. 7 January). *** Two independent tree dates disagreeing with the
# index in the SAME DIRECTION is the signature of a DEFAULT VALUE, not of two coincidental errors. ***
# *** SO THE AGE FIELD IN THESE COLLECTIONS IS NOT EVIDENCE FOR AN INFANT ***, and this archive will
# not use it to correct a birth date. Recorded in data/false-zeros.tsv as a disguise.
# ============ *** AND THE QUESTION THAT BROUGHT ME HERE IS STILL OPEN ============ ***
# *** CAREEN MARIA LERENA HAS NO CIVIL BIRTH OR DEATH RECORD INDEXED ANYWHERE IN SOUTH AFRICA. ***
# Searched by forename across the whole country: *** her only record is the Maitland cemetery
# entry ***. Work-list row 106 wanted a Cape birth or death registration to name her parents, and
# *** FamilySearch's South African civil indexes cannot supply one. *** The Cape civil registers
# themselves are held by the Department of Home Affairs and the Western Cape Archives; that is where
# the row now points.
